text: 财政部发布离岸信托个人所得税政策口径问答 在配售协议签署之日起14日内将新股发行给大股东同一离岸信托的，其卖出股票数量不超过买入股票数量的部分，可不视为转让信托财产，不调整股票财产原值。
text_en: Ministry of Finance issues Q&A on offshore trust individual income tax policy: where new shares are issued to the same offshore trust of a major shareholder within 14 days from the date of signing the placing agreement, the portion of shares sold not exceeding the number of shares bought may not be deemed a transfer of trust property, and the original value of the stock property shall not be adjusted.
